notes:
Intro: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics for mobile apps). Shortlist exercise focused on embeddings + semantic search.

Discovery: found they have an existing vector pipeline built on self-hosted Milvus + nightly Airflow jobs that create ~3M vectors per night (batch), and a realtime query surface that needs 120-150 qps 95th percentile. Current pain: inconsistent latencies under load, ops cost spikes, slow index rebuilds (up to 6 hours).

What they tried: PoC with Pinecone (stability good) but cost and vendor lock concerns. RedisVector used for caching hot shards. Existing infra: AWS (us-east-1), S3 for raw docs, Airflow, Terraform.

Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-12): "We need predictable tail latency and a plan for index rebuilds — if we have to take search offline for hours, that's unacceptable. Also want to avoid being boxed into a single managed vector provider."

Hosted API POC: kickoff 2026-02-20 — ingest pipeline mocked using Redwood hosted embeddings for 50k sample docs; integrated with Milvus connector in test env. Initial results: embedding quality comparable to baseline (cosine recall ~0.93 at k=10), median query latency 42ms via hosted -> vector DB (Pinecone staging), throughput limited by connector concurrency.

Dedicated demo: 2026-03-05 — showed Dedicated pool w/ reserved GPU, autoscaling policies, and VPC peering. SE demoed burst capacity handling 200 qps sustained with KV-prefix caching to reduce token cost. Customer liked the model pinning + rollback.

Security + Legal: SOC2 cert required; asking for KMS integration + audit logs in Dedicated. Data residency: must keep EU customer data in eu-central-1 for subset of customers (legal case).

Pricing convo: 2026-03-11 billing call. Key ask: predictable monthly committed spend with headroom for nightly batch jobs. They requested example TCO comparing Hosted vs Dedicated for 3 scenarios (baseline, growth x2, growth x5).

Technical constraints / POC goals:
- Throughput target: 120-200 qps for search surface (95th percentile)
- Batch embedding job: support ingest of 3M vectors nightly with parallel workers and resumable uploads
- Integration: connectors for Milvus / Pinecone / Redis + S3-based snapshot restore
- Model preferences: open embeddings with dense vectors (1536 dims) but willing to evaluate Redwood-verified small/medium quantized models for cost savings
- Latency SLO: median <50ms, p95 <200ms for search queries in production
- Cost sensitivity: mid; willing to commit to Dedicated if unit cost < $0.0008/vector (TBD)
